text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — HIGH error rate detected for apac-gateway /v1/generate (5xx > 15% over 3m). Severity: P1. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/model-degradation. Bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/12345. Oncall: mira (primary), samir (secondary).

mira: I'm inbound but currently on a flight with no reliable audio. I can handle brief msgs but can't join the bridge. Can someone take primary until I land? I'm happy to handoff.

jonah: I can take primary. Joining bridge now. :wave:

samir: I'll be secondary and watch for aftershock. setting my pager to loud. :thumbsup:

lee: Quick checklist from runbook — config + hotfix steps:
1) check NGINX errors: `kubectl logs -l app=apac-gateway -n prod --since=10m | grep 500`
2) check model-workers for OOM/restarts: 
```
kubectl describe pod -l role=model-worker -n prod | egrep "Restart|OOM"
kubectl logs -l role=model-worker -n prod --tail=200
```
3) If KV cache thrashing, restart worker with `k scale deploy model-worker --replicas=3 -n prod`

jonah: saw a spike in `model-worker` CPU and a few OOMs. Running the restart now (will do one node at a time):
```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-worker -n prod --selector=zone=apac-1
```

mira: thanks. Customer-impact note: we have increased 5xx for a handful of high-qps customers in APAC (workspace ids: 8237, 9012). Raising support ticket and notify CS on severity. Link to quick status: https://status.redwood/incidents/8237

incident-bot: Action taken: model-worker rollout started by jonah. Alert suppressed for 10m due to mitigation.

samir: after the restart 5xx dropped from 18% -> 2% in ~4m. Still monitoring. I can shadow-run the postmortem collection (logs + pprof).

lee: please grab a pprof from the hottest worker and upload to s3 with tag `apac-2026-regen` — run:
```
curl http://<worker-pod>:6060/debug/pprof/profile?seconds=30 > /tmp/profile.pb
aws s3 cp /tmp/profile.pb s3://redwood-temp/apac-2026-regen/
```

jonah: Bridge is up: https://meet.redwood/bridge/12345. I'm on bridge and will own updates. mira — if you need to re-take primary when you're back just ping and I'll hand back.

mira: appreciate it. handing off formal: I'm conceding primary to @jonah until 03:00 UTC (my ETA on landing). Please add any escalation notes in the bridge transcript.

samir: logged post-incident checklist entries and will run log-collection script:
```
python tools/collect_incident_data.py --svc apac-gateway --since 10m --out s3://redwood-incidents/4790012345/
```

jonah: all good to close pager if no regressions in 20m. I'll keep biz-impact updates to #incidents and DM CS leads with customer list.

lee: leaving a pin: add autoscale buffer for apac gateway + bump model-worker memory by 10% on next deployment. 

mira: thanks team. I'm back online in ~2h, will join the postmortem. Closing thread once we hit stable.

incident-bot: Pager resolved — error rate fell below threshold for 15 continuous minutes. Severity: mitigated. Record: https://incidents.redwood/4790012345
